metadata.dataset: Scania APS Failure - TRAINING set only

distributions.policy: Descriptive only. No transformation, scaling or removal is applied or implied.

leakage.policy: Flags are review prompts, not verdicts. A flag means 'look closer', and the absence of a flag does not rule out same-vehicle leakage, which APS data cannot reveal (no vehicle id).

missingness.policy: Descriptive only. No feature is removed or modified because of missingness; missingness is informative for this dataset. Any use of these rankings for feature selection must be re-derived inside cross-validation folds.

relationships.method: per-column average ranks, Pearson over rows where both are observed (exact Spearman when nothing is missing)
relationships.policy: Descriptive only. Redundant features are reported, never dropped.

signal.policy: Descriptive only. Computed on the full training set, so using these rankings to select features would leak; any selection must be re-derived inside CV folds.
